position: Configuration can be inspectable without exposing credentials
headline: The deployment contract carries names and boundaries, never secret values.
copy: Local, preview, and pilot environments now share one validated shape. Pilot configuration requires references for session signing and reviewer storage but cannot contain their values.

postures.title: Local
postures.copy: Loopback origins may run local checks without provider credentials.

postures.title: Preview
postures.copy: HTTPS origins and reference-only secrets are required.

postures.title: Pilot
postures.copy: A valid packet still cannot activate an endpoint.

flow.title: Validate
flow.copy: Reject unknown keys, values, writes, and unsafe origins.

flow.title: Redact
flow.copy: Return a safe summary with zero secret values.

decisions.label: Pilot references
decisions.reason: Session signing and reviewer store keys must be named.

decisions.label: Telemetry
decisions.reason: Raw questions and identity data remain excluded.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential has been activated.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Signed test sessions do not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: The queue repository is a reference implementation, not a connected durable store.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Readiness evidence cannot activate invitations or a public service.

packet:
VedaPath Environment & Secret Contract
Environments: local, preview, pilot
Origins: HTTPS; local loopback exception only
Secrets: managed references only
Required pilot refs: VEDAPATH_SESSION_SIGNING_SECRET, VEDAPATH_REVIEWER_STORE_KEY
Telemetry: privacy-safe aggregate only
Write routes: 0
Deployment: not activated
Public launch: blocked.
